item.text: The client currently sends priority changes immediately but allows the select to remain interactive, and re-renders can race outstanding saves. I’m checking the remainder of the task handlers to apply a small, consistent persistence fix that also protects due-date and completion edits.

item.text: I’ve added `keepalive` to the priority update request, so a navigation immediately after selecting a value won’t cancel that write. Next I’m doing syntax and launch/health checks, then I’ll commit the focused fix with a clean working tree.
